headline: **MLB Daily Recap: August 11, 2026**
article:
The Detroit Tigers secured a crucial 6-4 win over the Cleveland Guardians, while the Miami Marlins shut out the Pittsburgh Pirates 2-0. The Chicago Cubs edged out the Washington Nationals 8-6, and the New York Yankees took down the Seattle Mariners 4-1.

Injuries and availability impacted several teams, with the Los Angeles Dodgers transferring Blake Treinen to the 60-day injured list due to right elbow inflammation. The Boston Red Sox moved Isiah Kiner-Falefa to the 60-day injured list, while the New York Yankees placed Kervin Castro on the 15-day injured list. Other teams also reported injuries, including the Cincinnati Reds, Toronto Blue Jays, Miami Marlins, San Francisco Giants, and Colorado Rockies.

Several trades and roster movements took place, with the Kansas City Royals acquiring Jacob Berry from the Miami Marlins. The Athletics traded for Seth Johnson from the Philadelphia Phillies, and the Miami Marlins traded for Brandan Bidois from the Pittsburgh Pirates. The Colorado Rockies traded for Aiden May from the Miami Marlins.

top_news.title: **Tigers Take Down Guardians in Thrilling Finish**
top_news.summary: The Detroit Tigers edged out the Cleveland Guardians 6-4, securing a crucial win. Chase DeLauter led the Guardians' offense with 3 hits, including a home run, while Drew Anderson pitched 4 strong innings for the Guardians.

top_news.title: **Marlins Take Down Pirates in Shutout**
top_news.summary: The Miami Marlins secured a 2-0 victory over the Pittsburgh Pirates, with Eury Pérez pitching 7.0 innings of shutout baseball. Esteury Ruiz led the Marlins' offense with a home run and an RBI.

top_news.title: **Cubs Take Down Nationals 8-6**
top_news.summary: The Chicago Cubs secured an 8-6 victory over the Washington Nationals, with Seiya Suzuki leading the offense with 2 hits, 1 home run, and 2 RBIs. Jacob Webb earned the save with 1.1 scoreless innings, striking out 2 batters.

top_news.title: **Yankees Take Down Mariners 4-1**
top_news.summary: The New York Yankees secured a 4-1 victory over the Seattle Mariners, with Randy Arozarena leading the Mariners' offense with a home run and an RBI. Bryan Woo pitched 5 strong innings for the Mariners, striking out 5 batters and allowing 0 earned runs.

top_news.title: **Dodgers' Blake Treinen Shifted to 60-Day IL**
top_news.summary: Los Angeles Dodgers right-handed pitcher Blake Treinen has been transferred from the 15-day injured list to the 60-day injured list due to right elbow inflammation.

top_news.title: **Royals Acquire Jacob Berry in Trade**
top_news.summary: The Kansas City Royals have made a move to bolster their lineup, acquiring first baseman Jacob Berry from the Miami Marlins. Berry joins the Royals' roster as part of a trade.
